title: Ecomarket
tagline: EcoMarket is a decentralized circular economy marketplace for sustainable goods.
description: Built on the Hedera network, it leverages smart contracts for trustless escrow, fair pricing, provenance tracking, and tokenized incentives for environmental action. Creating a sustainable future where waste becomes resource, and every environmental action is rewarded. EcoMarket transforms the traditional linear economy into a circular one through blockchain technology and community-driven sustainability.
how_its_made:
✨ Key Features
🛍️ Marketplace
Sustainable Product Trading: Buy and sell eco-friendly products with verified sustainability scores
Category-based Filtering: 8+ specialized categories for different sustainable materials
Local Sourcing Priority: Support local circular economy initiatives
Smart Pricing: AI-assisted fair pricing based on carbon impact and sustainability metrics
🔄 Recycling Rewards
Activity Reporting: Submit recycling activities with photo verification
Instant Rewards: Earn EcoReward (ECO) tokens for environmental actions
Carbon Impact Tracking: Real-time CO₂ savings calculation and tracking
Gamification: Level system (Bronze → Silver → Gold → Platinum)
🏆 Analytics & Leaderboards
Global Impact Dashboard: Track collective carbon savings and environmental impact
User Leaderboards: Compete with community members for top sustainability rankings
Progress Visualization: Beautiful charts and metrics for personal and global progress
Certification System: Verify and showcase environmental credentials
🔐 Blockchain Features
Hedera Token Service: Native tokenization with ECO reward tokens
Smart Escrow: Secure, trustless transaction handling
Provenance Tracking: Complete product lifecycle transparency
Decentralized Identity: Secure user management without centralized control
